name: Cyberbulli
source:
It's 2005, and Emily's best friend Kayla is being harassed by an anonymous cyberbully on MySpace.

But Emily is there to defend and comfort her...

And be the only person in the world that Kayla could ever need.

[From [url=https://oroboro.itch.io/cyberbulli]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2005年，艾米丽最好的朋友凯拉在MySpace上受到匿名网络欺凌者的骚扰。

但艾米丽却在那里保护和安慰她……

成为世界上凯拉唯一需要的人。

[来自[url=https://oroboro.itch.io/cyberbulli]Itch.io[/url]]
